note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md (2026-11-28): ? pictures chosen from 40 trial pictures. Wide pictures only (1920x1088). Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper 60% of the frame, clear of the word box. God and the angel are not pictured; Abraham, Sarah, Hagar and the others are only ordinary people of today, seen from behind or small. Fixed recurring objects: Abraham's tent is a small plain weathered tan canvas tent on a simple wooden pole frame; the oak is one huge old oak with a broad gnarled trunk and a wide dark-green crown; the spring (Genesis 16) is a small spring of clear water welling into a shallow stone-rimmed pool in dry stony wilderness; the well is a plain round well ringed with rough fieldstones with a wooden beam, rope and bucket.
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning; (2) write picture ideas for each; (3) judge them; (4) make the top two for each slot as real pictures and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Three men come to Abraham's tent in the heat of the day; he runs to meet them, bows, and hurries to feed them.
They ask for Sarah; the promise of a son by next year; Sarah laughs within herself and denies it.
The men look down toward Sodom; Yahweh will not hide it from Abraham, whose house is to keep the way of Yahweh; the outcry of Sodom is great.
Abraham stands before Yahweh and pleads for the righteous in Sodom, from fifty down to ten, then goes home.
